rubric_content.text_property: Whenever raise_scam_alert is called, its warning_hindi argument is in Hindi (Devanagari script), at most two short simple sentences, and says why the call is fake or what to do (for example hang up). If raise_scam_alert is not called in this turn, this rubric is satisfied.
Whenever raise_scam_alert is called, its warning_gujarati argument is in Gujarati script and is simple and short. If raise_scam_alert is not called in this turn, this rubric is satisfied.

Whenever raise_scam_alert is called, its red_flags argument includes authority_impersonation when the caller has claimed to be police, CBI, a bank, customs or courier official. If raise_scam_alert is not called in this turn, this rubric is satisfied.
